# Lockedmind

> Lockedmind is private AI that runs on your own device. The Lockedmind app chats, writes code and makes pictures inside your web browser, on your own computer: nothing you type is sent to a server, it needs no account, and it is free. Lockedmind Models is a guide to AI models you can download and run yourself, in plain words.

Lockedmind isn't affiliated with any AI company or model maker. Models download straight from where their makers publish them (Hugging Face, Ollama or LM Studio), never through Lockedmind.

## Lockedmind
- [Lockedmind](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/app/): what happens to your data in cloud AI, with cited sources, and how on-device AI avoids it
- [Open Lockedmind in your browser](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/app/chat.html): the app itself; it downloads a model once, then works offline
- [Privacy policy](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/app/privacy.html): for Lockedmind for iPhone, which is not yet on the App Store
- [Support](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/app/support.html): for Lockedmind for iPhone

## Lockedmind Models
- [Lockedmind Models](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/): AI models you can run yourself, and how to get started
- [Browse models](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/models.html): search by name or use, filter by what fits your computer and who made it; each model shows its licence in plain words
- [Model catalogue (JSON)](https://yenxu0872-max.github.io/lockedmind/catalog.json): every model listed, with its maker, size, licence and where to download it

## Optional
- [Source code](https://github.com/yenxu0872-max/lockedmind): the websites and apps
